abstract: A 54-year-old man presented with a very rare case of radiation-induced intramedullary spinal cord anaplastic astrocytoma, which developed 37 years after radiotherapy for testicular seminoma. The patient presented with weakness and numbness of the left lower extremity that had gradually aggravated for 3 months. Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated an intramedullary mass lesion with syringomyelia at the T9 to T12 levels. Subtotal removal of the tumor was performed using standard microsurgical technique. Histological examination revealed anaplastic astrocytoma. Although radiotherapy was seriously considered, chemotherapy was employed as adjuvant therapy considering the previous treatment. Although his neurological status improved transiently after surgery, relentless neurological decline occurred and resulted in death 9 months following surgery. Considering that subtotal removal of the tumor and chemotherapy had little influence on the quality of life and the length of survival in our case, cordectomy may be the optimum treatment for patients with radiation-induced spinal intramedullary malignant astrocytoma.
abstract_ja: 54歳男性が、精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法から37年後に放射線誘発性脊髄内未分化星細胞腫を発症した非常に稀な症例を呈した。患者は3か月にわたって徐々に悪化する左下肢の脱力と感覚障害を訴えた。MRIでT9からT12レベルに脊髄空洞症を伴う脊髄内腫瘤病変を認めた。標準的な顕微鏡手術により腫瘍の亜全摘術を行った。病理組織学的検査で未分化星細胞腫と診断された。放射線療法も強く検討されたが、前回の治療を考慮して化学療法が補助療法として選択された。術後に神経学的所見は一時的に改善したが、その後も持続的な神経症状の悪化が生じ、術後9か月で死亡した。本症例では腫瘍の亜全摘術と化学療法がQOLや生存期間にほとんど影響しなかったと考えられることから、放射線誘発性脊髄内悪性星細胞腫に対する最適な治療は脊髄切除術(cordectomy)である可能性がある。
